# Brandon Allan Fluegel, Ph.D. — Human Factors Portfolio

> Senior Human Factors Design Engineer at Intuitive Surgical, focused on surgical robotics. Ph.D. in Human Factors Psychology; prior work at Amazon, NASA, and Mercedes-Benz.

## Profile
- **Current role:** Senior Human Factors Design Engineer at Intuitive Surgical.
- **Focus:** Human factors design for surgical robotics and complex systems.
- **Education:** Ph.D. in Human Factors Psychology, Old Dominion University.
- **Prior project experience:** Human factors research and engineering projects at Amazon Devices Design Group, NASA Lunar Gateway, and Mercedes-Benz.
- **Areas of experience:** Human factors engineering, surgical and medical robotics, human-machine interaction, simulated-use validation, psychophysics, cognitive workload, and Human-AI interaction.

## Portfolio
- [Amazon research and patent project](https://www.humanfactors.pro/#amazon-section)
- [NASA Lunar Gateway workstation validation](https://www.humanfactors.pro/#nasa-section)

## Selected Prior-Work Outcomes
- **Amazon:** Identified a 1,000 ms Alexa response High Satisfaction Threshold in a 20,000+ trial study. Alexa Economics projected $50M+ in operational value over 15 months from meeting latency targets. Co-invented US Patent 12,532,040 B1 and received the 2023 Amazon Inventor Award.
- **NASA:** Lunar Gateway workstation validation reduced complex medical procedure time-on-task by 30% versus baseline.
- **Mercedes-Benz:** L2 HMI and psychoacoustic research reported a 24% increase in driver trust scores and 15% lower perceived cabin noise.
